decisions.choice: Lowers the final score, never below zero
decisions.why: A hint helps, so it should count, but not wipe out the score.

replies.text: Good point. Should the interviewer turn the walkthrough off for a whole interview, or per question?

revised.explanation: Hints escalate from a nudge to a walkthrough, and the interviewer can switch the walkthrough off.

choices.label: Per interview
choices.description: One switch in the interview's settings.

choices.label: Both
choices.description: An interview default that a question can override.

round.title: How many hints per interview?
round.explanation: The number of hints decides how much help a candidate can get in total.

choices.label: Set in each interview's config
choices.description: Each interview type chooses its own number.

choices.label: Always 3
choices.description: One fixed number for every interview.

choices.label: No limit
choices.description: The penalty alone keeps hints in check.

round.title: Where does a hint appear?
round.explanation: The hint should be easy to read without hiding the code.

choices.label: In a side panel
choices.description: Next to the editor, kept for the whole interview.

choices.label: In the chat
choices.description: As a message from the interviewer.

choices.label: In a popup
choices.description: Shown over the editor until closed.

round.title: Does the interviewer see the hints given?
round.explanation: Interviewers may want to know how much help was needed.

choices.label: In the final report
choices.description: Each hint and its level, after the interview.

choices.label: Live
choices.description: Hints show up for the interviewer as they happen.

choices.label: No
choices.description: Hints are private to the candidate.
